name: SHREEJI SOJITRA
idea: I am starting a small online bakery business that sells customized cakes, pastries, and desserts. I want a software system to manage customers, orders, cake customization requests, payments, delivery schedules, inventory, and notifications.

consultantConversation.content: I am starting a small online bakery that sells customized cakes, pastries, cupcakes, and other desserts. Customers should be able to browse the available products, select cake size and flavor, upload reference images for custom designs, add special instructions, and place orders online. The bakery team needs to manage customer information, orders, customization requests, payments, inventory, and delivery schedules. Customers should receive notifications about order confirmation, preparation status, and delivery. The system should also provide dashboards and reports for sales, inventory, and order management.

recommendations.text: Use a modular e-commerce platform (e.g., Shopify or WooCommerce) with a custom plugin for cake customization to accelerate development.
recommendations.explanation: These platforms provide built‑in inventory, payment, and notification capabilities, reducing time to market.

recommendations.text: Implement a RESTful API backend (Node.js + PostgreSQL) to handle order processing, inventory, and customization logic.
recommendations.explanation: A decoupled API allows future expansion (mobile app, third‑party integrations) without redesigning the core.

recommendations.text: Integrate a notification service (Twilio, Firebase Cloud Messaging) for order status updates.
recommendations.explanation: Reliable push/email notifications improve customer experience and reduce support queries.

assumptions: The bakery has limited technical resources and prefers a low‑maintenance solution.
Operations are confined to a single geographic region with local delivery.
